correctness.rationale: PASS: For the exactly normalized two-stage Radau endpoint R(z)=(6-2z)/(z²+4z+6), the three Laplacian eigenspaces on K_{s,...,s} give the diagonal, within-part, and cross-part entries stated in the frozen RESULT.md. The cross-part sign is 1-R(mt)>0, while a direct rational identity makes all within-part offdiagonals positive for t>0. The scalar minimum rho=(5-3sqrt(3))/2 gives 1+10rho>0 for n<=11. At t=6/(m-1) diagonal is nonpositive for n>=12 and strictly negative except (m,s)=(2,6), where t=8 has exact numerator -500/8313. The diagonal numerator equals quartic F_{m,s}; its coefficient signs have at most two positive roots by Descartes, and the two sign crossings force exactly two simple roots. Independent SymPy algebra reconstructed F and the offdiagonal identity and isolated two positive roots for (2,6),(3,4),(12,1),(3,5),(4,3),(5,3),(100,1), with none for checked n<12. The finite tests do not replace the all-m,s argument.
